selector_decision.rationale: No offered cluster is an eligible new, narrow, non-security bug fix. The only clearly bounded bug-fix PR (#51762) already has an open implementation with focused tests and a recorded merge commit SHA, so it is covered work rather than a new ClawSweeper target. The remaining open candidates are feature/product or architecture proposals, existing PR work, closed work, or security-sensitive and require routing.

assessments.rationale: #22438 is a feature proposal requiring maintainer and product decisions, and it is already implemented by the open linked PR #22439. The implementation changes configuration and bootstrap/session-context behavior across ten files and is marked as waiting on the author with compatibility and session-state risk. It is not an unclaimed narrow bug fix.
The sole member, PR #18778, is closed, unmerged, draft-originated work with a dirty/unmergeable state. It is also a large Discord/gateway feature and is not still-open, review-ready bug-fix work.
This is a large security-sensitive enforcement proposal spanning gateway, CLI, UI, agent, and documentation surfaces, with 29 changed files and a needs-proof status. It requires security routing.

#9764 proposes optional user OAuth support and new credential/configuration behavior rather than a narrow bug fix. Repository evidence marks it as requiring both product decision and security review. It requires security routing.

#67419 combines several policy/default changes: enabling an existing option by default, changing memory-loading behavior, and delivering a separately referenced dynamic-file configuration. The issue itself says existing mechanics already address part of it, while the remaining choices require maintainer/product decisions and affect session state.

PR #51762 is a narrow, tested bug fix, but it is already covered by an active implementation: it has one current commit, focused tests, runtime proof, and a recorded merge commit SHA despite the API still reporting open. Selecting duplicate implementation work would not be useful.

#11517 is an architecture refactor proposal for dependency injection across highly coupled runtime and Discord modules. It has no concrete defect reproduction or bounded fix and explicitly needs maintainer/product direction.

#7707 is a broad security-oriented feature request involving memory provenance, retention, retrieval policy, and UI. It requires product and maintainer decisions and security routing rather than a standalone non-security bug fix.
